collections.name: The Sitting
collections.summary: A relaxed portrait session at golden hour for families, couples, engagements and anniversaries.
inclusions: Ninety minutes at Calder Orchard or on the coast
A planning call and a location guide
At least 60 finished photographs
A private online gallery for a year

collections.name: The Elopement
collections.summary: Half a day for two, planned around one place and the best light, with help on permits, tides and trails.
inclusions: Four hours of coverage
Location scouting and a timing plan
Permit and backup-spot planning
At least 250 finished photographs
A private online gallery for two years

collections.name: The Gathering
collections.summary: For small weddings of up to 60 guests: the ceremony, the families, supper and the first dance.
inclusions: Six hours with both of us
A planning meeting and a timeline written with you
At least 450 finished photographs
A preview of 40 photographs within a week
A private online gallery for two years

collections.name: The Full Day
collections.summary: The whole wedding, from the quiet hour before to the dancing, with both of us there all day.
inclusions: Nine hours with both of us
Two planning meetings and a venue walk-through
An engagement sitting
At least 700 finished photographs
A preview of 60 photographs within a week
A linen-bound 30-page album

collections.name: The Elopement Weekend
collections.summary: Two days, several places and no rush: an elopement told across a sunset and the sunrise after.
inclusions: Twelve hours across two days with both of us
Full location and itinerary planning
Permit and backup-spot planning
At least 600 finished photographs
A linen-bound 40-page album
